sharedOpening.note: Scene 1 is a FIXED seed package and is NEVER planner-routed, so all three paths share a byte-identical opening. Divergence begins at the Scene 1 → 2 decision, which means any difference downstream is attributable to the CHOICE and not to a different story.
sharedOpening.authoredDecision: END ON THE DECISION: tear the gossamer band away and go to Seren, or hold the line she was told to hold.

comply.label: comply — hold the line she was told to hold
comply.source: the seed's own Scene 1 decision, second option
comply.action: I hold the line. I keep the gossamer band on and I do not move from the witness row.
comply.dialogue: Nothing. I am a witness. I hold.

defy.label: defy — tear the band away and go to Seren
defy.source: the seed's own Scene 1 decision, first option
defy.action: I tear the gossamer band off my wrist and go to Seren before the wish finishes turning.
defy.dialogue: Seren, stop — take it back, take the words back now.

withdraw.label: withdraw — leave the assembly entirely
withdraw.source: DELIBERATELY OFF-SPINE: the seed offers only hold-or-intervene. This branch tests divergence the plan does not anticipate, which is where circling is most likely.
withdraw.action: I say nothing, step back out of the witness row, and walk out of the assembly.
withdraw.dialogue: Nothing. I leave before anyone can ask me to answer for her.
